de: Tarnów gilt als die wärmste Stadt Polens.
Die Altstadt ist perfekt für einen gemächlichen Spaziergang.
Achten Sie auf die Bem-Gedenkorte in der ganzen Stadt.
hu: Az óváros tökéletes egy kényelmes sétához.
Keresse Bem József emlékhelyeit szerte a városban.
ro: Tarnów este considerat cel mai călduros oraș din Polonia.
Orașul vechi este perfect pentru o plimbare lentă.
Căutați locurile comemorative dedicate lui Bem în oraș.
en: Tarnów is considered the warmest city in Poland.
The old town is perfect for a leisurely stroll.
Look for General Bem memorials throughout the city.

en.name: Tarnów Tea
en.tip: Try the unique local herbal tea blends.

en.name: Regional Wine
en.tip: Tarnów is a key center for Polish winemaking.

en.name: Strzelecki Park
